title: [Bug]: pc/test_lag_member.py failed to run 'supervisorctl restart arp_responder'
author: dayouliu1
body:
### Issue Description

`supervisorctl restart arp_responder` is failing to run during setup of `arp_responder` in `pc/test_lag_member.py`

### Results you see

Test fails with `arp_responder: ERROR (not running)`

### Results you expected to see

Test should pass

### Is it platform specific

generic

### Relevant log output

```shell
failed on setup with "Failed: Setup failed with error: run module shell failed, Ansible Results =>
```
